clue.text: Relative rejected appeal to go the rounds

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the word for relative is read from its end

parts.note: bro is short for brother, a relative
IT is sex appeal, as in the old phrase for allure

explanation.surface: Someone spurned by a family member's plea goes doing the rounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns BRO into ORB.
explanation.definitionFit: To circle repeatedly around something, as a planet does the sun, is to make rounds.

clue.text: Run out of space on the press

parts.note: on can mean over, as in a lid on or over a jar
a press is a thronging crowd

explanation.surface: A newspaper runs out of room for its stories.
explanation.definitionFit: To pack too many people into a place, so that room runs out.

clue.text: Cry heard by holder of 15 when crossing meadow

indicators.note: crossing means stretching across, so the baronet's letters go around the meadow

parts.note: BT is the abbreviation for baronet, who holds the rank at 15 down
lea is a poetic word for a meadow

explanation.surface: A titled landowner hears a cry as he walks across a field.
explanation.walkthrough: The 15 answer is a baronet's rank, so its holder is a baronet, Bt.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheep's or goat's call is what one hears in the field.

clue.text: Establishes contact with people who part with money

definitions.meaning: makes physical contact, puts a hand on
a soft touch is someone easily persuaded to lend or give cash

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means makes contact; as a noun plural, it is slang for easy marks who hand over loans.

clue.text: In the continent, right time to develop plant

indicators.note: In at the front says the following pieces go inside the continent's name

parts.note: Asia is the largest continent

indicators.note: to develop is to change form, so the letters of time are rearranged

explanation.surface: A gardener says that in Asia the right moment has come for a plant to grow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to develop' turns TIME into TEMI; R + TEMI goes inside ASIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Artemisia is a genus of aromatic herbs including wormwood and tarragon.

clue.text: In the bloody Tube, mostly, one's tense

indicators.note: In at the front says the following piece goes inside the shortened vessel
mostly means almost all, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: the aorta is the main artery, a tube carrying blood
one's means one is, giving I and S

explanation.surface: A London commuter is stressed by the awful Underground most of the time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the final A of AORTA; IS goes inside AORT. 'Bloody' is literal: carrying blood, not the British swearword.
explanation.definitionFit: A Greek verb form expressing simple past action is a grammatical tense.

clue.text: New rate about 10p a year? He'd be delighted

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the anagram goes around the rest
New signals that the letters of rate take a new arrangement

parts.note: X is the Roman ten and P is penny

explanation.surface: A fresh tax rate cut to around ten pence a year would please someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' makes TAER from RATE; it goes about XPAY.
explanation.definitionFit: One who pays tax would be pleased by a rate cut that low.

clue.text: Little fare, do we infer, in this saloon?

definitions.text: Little fare, do we infer, in this saloon?

parts.words: Little fare, do we infer, in this saloon?
parts.note: reads as cheap food in a bar, but it is a small car for hire, fare being the passenger's payment and saloon a car body style

explanation.definitionFit: A small hire car booked by phone, as opposed to a hailed taxi, charges a fare to riders.

clue.text: Histories about the Channel Islands, where French proved far-sighted

indicators.note: about means around, so the histories surround the other pieces

parts.note: sagas are long historical tales
CI is the abbreviation for the Channel Islands
ou is French for where

explanation.surface: Accounts of the Channel Islands' French past turn out to be wise.
explanation.walkthrough: CI + OU goes inside SAGAS.
explanation.definitionFit: Wise and shrewd, showing good judgement about the future.

clue.text: Crime gets cloth-worker executed

indicators.note: executed here means beheaded, so the first letter is cut off

parts.note: a parson is a man of the cloth, a clergyman

explanation.surface: A weaver is put to death for an offence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cloth-worker' suggests a weaver; it is a clergyman. 'executed' takes the head, P, off PARSON.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberately setting fire to property is a criminal offence.

clue.text: Old city jokes heard about superior female appointee

parts.note: ex means former or old, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: about means going around, so the city and the jokes surround the next piece

parts.note: EC is the postcode of the City of London

indicators.note: heard says a word is spoken, and we write what it sounds like

parts.note: tricks are pranks or jokes
U stands for upper class, socially superior

explanation.surface: An ancient city's jests are overheard concerning a woman of higher rank who has been appointed.
explanation.walkthrough: TRIX sounds like 'tricks'; EC + TRIX goes around U, after EX.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman named in a will to carry out its terms is a female executor, an appointed role.

clue.text: A drink for the emperor

definitions.meaning: a hot mixture of wine, sugar and spices
the title of the ruler of Ethiopia

explanation.definitionFit: Negus is both a mulled wine punch named after Colonel Negus and the Ethiopian title for a king of kings.

clue.text: Wrestling in which two rounds can involve a second

indicators.note: involve means to take in, so the second piece is placed inside the first
two says the word for rounds appears twice in a row

parts.note: a catch is a round, a song sung in overlapping parts

explanation.surface: A form of wrestling where two bouts might feature a helper in the corner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'two' doubles CATCH; 'involve' puts AS inside CATCHCATCHCAN. A catch is a musical round, not a boxing round.
explanation.definitionFit: Catch-as-catch-can is a freestyle style of wrestling allowing holds anywhere on the body.

clue.text: Lives in NW town without a motorway, being elderly

indicators.note: in says the word for lives sits inside the shortened town
without means lacking, so the letters for a and motorway are dropped

parts.note: Oldham is a town in north-west England, near Manchester
M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in M1
is, as in he is, means he exists or lives

explanation.surface: An older person lives in a north-western English town far from any motorway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes A and M from OLDHAM, leaving OLDH; IS goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Somewhat old, getting on in years, is the meaning of the suffixed adjective.

clue.text: Height of soldiers replacing six in army formation?

indicators.note: replacing says one piece takes the place of another inside the formation

parts.note: a division is a large army unit
VI is six in Roman numerals
men are ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: How tall troops stand when swapped for six in a military unit.
explanation.walkthrough: MEN replaces VI in DIVISION.
explanation.definitionFit: Height is one measurement of size, along with length and breadth.

clue.text: Again take in dreadful bar bores

indicators.note: dreadful suggests something mangled or awful, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Tiresome pub bores are hard to stomach a second time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dreadful' rearranges BARBORES.
explanation.definitionFit: To soak up or absorb once more is the meaning.

clue.text: Rank of one going to Eton by car, perhaps?

indicators.note: perhaps suggests one possible arrangement, so the letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A boy of high rank is driven to Eton, the English private school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges ETONBYCAR. Eton is an elite English boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: The hereditary title of a baronet is this rank.

clue.text: Direction of movement of fish among rocks

indicators.note: among means in the midst of, so the fish goes inside

parts.note: rocks as a verb means sways back and forth
the ide is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Which way a fish swims through boulders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rocks' looks like a noun; it is the verb, SWAYS.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving to one side, crabwise, describes a direction of motion.

clue.text: Household heads given credit for speaking out

indicators.note: speaking out says the pieces are said aloud and we write what they sound like

parts.note: domes are heads, and tick is credit, as in buying on tick

explanation.surface: Family heads get credit for speaking their minds.
explanation.walkthrough: DOMES + TICK, said aloud, sounds like the answer. 'On tick' is British slang for on credit.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the home and family is the adjective's sense.

clue.text: Muslim leader originally functioning as law officer

parts.note: a sherif (sharif) is a Muslim ruler descended from Muhammad

indicators.note: originally means at the start, so the first letter is taken

explanation.surface: An Islamic leader who first served as a legal official.
explanation.definitionFit: A county official who keeps the peace and enforces the law.

clue.text: Vituperative words from this sailor and drug addict

parts.note: AB is able-bodied seaman, a sailor
a user is someone who takes drugs habitually

explanation.surface: A seaman who is also a junkie lets fly with foul language.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who hurls insults and invective is the one giving the abuse.

clue.text: Posh function — one held by man up in small private room

indicators.note: held by means contained inside, so the pieces go within the reversed name
up in a down clue says the word is read from the bottom

parts.note: Rob is a man's name
U means upper class, posh
a do is a party or function
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A posh party guest is cornered by a man upstairs in a private chamber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns ROB into BOR, which holds UDOI.
explanation.definitionFit: A lady's private sitting room or bedroom, from the French for sulk.

clue.text: Energetic type upset a large number, interrupting work

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking into, so the reversed word goes inside

parts.note: do means work, as in do a job

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: many means a large number

explanation.surface: A lively person upsets a crowd by breaking into a job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns MANY into YNAM, which goes inside DO.
explanation.definitionFit: An extremely energetic, hard-working person is called a powerhouse.

clue.text: A call to arms from Berlin

definitions.text: A call to arms from Berlin

parts.words: A call to arms from Berlin
parts.note: reads like a German military summons, but Berlin is the songwriter Irving Berlin and this is the title of his musical

explanation.definitionFit: Irving Berlin wrote the 1946 musical about sharpshooter Annie Oakley, whose title urges a girl to arm herself.

clue.text: Like a jolly sort of clock

parts.note: a la is French for in the manner of, like
a jolly is slang for a Royal Marine, RM

explanation.surface: A cheerful kind of timepiece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jolly' looks like 'cheerful'; it is a Royal Marine.
explanation.definitionFit: A clock that rings to wake you is this kind.

clue.text: Run in breathing apparatus from cooker on fire

indicators.note: in says the letter for run goes inside the breathing organ

parts.note: a gill is a fish's breathing organ
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Someone runs in breathing gear away from a burning stove.
explanation.definitionFit: A gridiron for cooking food over direct heat or flames.

clue.text: First-class politician taken in by Macavity's plea

indicators.note: taken in by means held inside, so the politician goes inside the first-class letters

parts.note: A1 means first-class, written AI
Lib is short for Liberal, a politician

explanation.surface: A top-rate politician is fooled by a cat's excuse.
explanation.walkthrough: Macavity is T. S. Eliot's mystery cat who 'always has an alibi'. A1 is written AI.
explanation.definitionFit: A claim of having been elsewhere when the crime happened is the defence Macavity always offers.

clue.text: Skilled dissector, or a believer in Dalton's theory?

definitions.meaning: an expert in bodily structure who cuts up bodies
John Dalton proposed that matter is made of atoms; split, the word reads as one who holds that view

explanation.definitionFit: A specialist in bodily structure cuts up cadavers; split as two words it is someone who believes in atoms, as Dalton did.

clue.text: Policy declaration a Chinese leader frames if in retreat

indicators.note: frames means surrounds, so the leader's name goes around the rest

parts.note: Mao Zedong led communist China

indicators.note: in says the word if goes inside the retreat

parts.note: a nest is a cosy hideaway or retreat

explanation.surface: A Chinese leader's policy statement has him pulling back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in retreat' looks like a reversal sign; in fact IF goes in NEST, making NIFEST, which MAO then frames.
explanation.definitionFit: A published statement of a party's aims and policies.

clue.text: It's a motoring event, actually, out east

indicators.note: out means removed, so the letter for east is taken away

parts.note: really means actually or in truth
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: Someone insists that it truly is a car event, though in the east.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitive car race over public or off roads, as in the Monte Carlo event.
